strings.zh: 小银『终于被我追上了吧,炎帝。{NEWLINE}现在跟阿鲁夫遗迹时不一样了,{CLEAR}我的实力远强于当时,{CLEAR}而你没了未知图腾的力量加持,{CLEAR}也并非不可战胜。{CLEAR}今天我一定能收服你！
strings.en: Silver: Finally caught up with{NEWLINE}you, Entei. Things are different{CLEAR}from the Ruins of Alph.{SCROLL}I’m far stronger than I was then,{NEWLINE}and without the Unown’s power{CLEAR}backing you, you’re not invincible.{SCROLL}Today I’m catching you for sure!

strings.zh: 炎帝『Ennn——tei！
strings.en: Entei: Ennn-tei!

strings.zh: 小银『上啊大力鳄,使出水流喷射！
strings.en: Silver: Go, Feraligatr! Use Aqua Jet!

strings.zh: 大力鳄『Feee——ra！
strings.en: Feraligatr: Feee-ra!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『现在你们看住小银大人,{NEWLINE}给我留足控制炎帝的时间。
strings.en: Ariana: Keep Master Silver busy. Give me{NEWLINE}plenty of time to take control of Entei.

strings.zh: 小银『好,炎帝已经显现出疲态了。{NEWLINE}现在正是扔球的时机！
strings.en: Silver: Good, Entei’s starting to{NEWLINE}tire. Now’s the time to throw a Ball!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『谢谢你啊小银大人,{NEWLINE}帮我们省了不少功夫。
strings.en: Ariana: Thank you, Master Silver.{NEWLINE}You’ve saved us a lot of trouble.

strings.zh: 小银『雅典娜？！
strings.en: Silver: Ariana?!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『使用穿插阵型,{NEWLINE}把小银大人和炎帝分开。
strings.en: Ariana: Use the interception formation.{NEWLINE}Separate Master Silver from Entei.

strings.zh: 是！
strings.en: Yes, ma’am!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 小银『可恶,这只炎帝是我的。{NEWLINE}你给我闪一边去！
strings.en: Silver: Dammit, this Entei{NEWLINE}is mine. Get out of my way!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『没错,炎帝应当属于您。{NEWLINE}但您的也就是我们火箭队的。{CLEAR}所以就由我来替您抓捕这只炎帝吧。
strings.en: Ariana: Quite right, Entei{NEWLINE}ought to be yours. But what’s{CLEAR}yours is Team Rocket’s.{SCROLL}So allow me to catch this{NEWLINE}Entei on your behalf.

strings.zh: 小银『呸！我才不是你们火箭队的人！{NEWLINE}你离炎帝远点！
strings.en: Silver: Pah! I’m not one of your{NEWLINE}Team Rocket! Get away from Entei!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『您再这样叛逆下去,{NEWLINE}坂木大人回来时会伤心的。
strings.en: Ariana: If you keep rebelling{NEWLINE}like this, Boss Giovanni will be{CLEAR}heartbroken when he returns.

strings.zh: 小银『我才看不上他那{NEWLINE}统治世界的无聊理想呢。{CLEAR}总有一天我会亲自打败他,{CLEAR}向他证明只有做一个纯粹的训练家{CLEAR}才能成为最强！
strings.en: Silver: I couldn’t care less about{NEWLINE}his stupid dream of ruling the world.{SCROLL}Someday I’ll beat him myself{NEWLINE}and prove to him that only a true{CLEAR}Trainer can become the strongest!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『您连炎帝都捉不住,{NEWLINE}可离最强还差得远呢。
strings.en: Ariana: You can’t even catch an Entei.{NEWLINE}You’re a long way from the strongest.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『放出控制装置。
strings.en: Ariana: Release the control device.

strings.zh: 小银『那是什么东西……？！
strings.en: Silver: What is that thing...?!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『这是专门为了收服三圣兽{NEWLINE}而研发的最新产品。{CLEAR}本来是需要一树的超能力配合{CLEAR}才能控制住三圣兽。{CLEAR}但多亏你刚才耗光了炎帝的体力,{CLEAR}现在即使没有超能力,{CLEAR}应该也能控制住炎帝了。
strings.en: Ariana: It’s our newest product,{NEWLINE}developed specifically to{CLEAR}capture the legendary beasts.{SCROLL}Normally it needs Will’s psychic powers{NEWLINE}to hold one of them under control.{SCROLL}But thanks to you draining Entei’s{NEWLINE}strength just now, we should be able to{CLEAR}control it even without psychic powers.

strings.zh: 小银『真是卑鄙的方法！
strings.en: Silver: What a dirty trick!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『对火箭对来说{NEWLINE}只有成功与失败,{CLEAR}没有高尚与卑鄙。{CLEAR}这点您应该也很清楚吧。
strings.en: Ariana: For Team Rocket, there’s{NEWLINE}only success and failure.{CLEAR}There’s no noble or dirty. Surely{CLEAR}you know that as well as anyone.

strings.zh: 小银『可恶,突不过去啊……
strings.en: Silver: Dammit, I can’t break through...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我来帮你,小银！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ll help you, Silver!

strings.zh: 小银『是你！
strings.en: Silver: You!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『这个危险的家伙{NEWLINE}到卡吉镇来了吗……
strings.en: Ariana: So that dangerous character{NEWLINE}has come to Mahogany Town...
strings.notes: RV046: addition: 家伙 is neutral; 'pest' added an insult

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我在湛蓝市附近遇到过{NEWLINE}火箭队用那个装置抓捕雷公。{CLEAR}只要破坏那个装置,{CLEAR}他们就无法控制炎帝了。{CLEAR}咱们现在一起打退火箭队,{CLEAR}破坏装置救出炎帝！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Near Cianwood City,{NEWLINE}I ran into Team Rocket using{CLEAR}that device to catch Raikou.{SCROLL}If we destroy the device, they{NEWLINE}won’t be able to control Entei.{SCROLL}Let’s drive off Team Rocket together,{NEWLINE}destroy the device and save Entei!

strings.zh: 小银『切……{NEWLINE}你会为你今天的决定后悔的,{CLEAR}等我抓到了炎帝,{CLEAR}很快就能超越你成为最强！
strings.en: Silver: Tch... You’ll regret this.{NEWLINE}Once I catch Entei, I’ll soon surpass{CLEAR}you and become the strongest!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那到时候咱们就来一场{NEWLINE}堂堂正正的精灵对决,{CLEAR}看看到底谁才是最强的。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『不过现在不是{NEWLINE}胡思乱想的时候,{CLEAR}先打败火箭队再说吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then when that day{NEWLINE}comes, let’s have a fair and{CLEAR}square Pokémon battle and see{CLEAR}who’s really the strongest.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: But now’s not the{NEWLINE}time to daydream. Let’s{CLEAR}beat Team Rocket first!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那等你收服炎帝之后,{NEWLINE}咱们就来一场堂堂正正的对决。{CLEAR}到时候如果你能超过我,{CLEAR}也未必就是坏事哟。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『不过现在不是{NEWLINE}胡思乱想的时候,{CLEAR}先打败火箭队再说吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then once you’ve caught{NEWLINE}Entei, let’s have a fair and square{CLEAR}battle. If you surpass me then,{CLEAR}that might not be a bad thing.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: But now’s not the{NEWLINE}time to daydream. Let’s{CLEAR}beat Team Rocket first!

strings.zh: 小银『好,我就跟你合作一次,{NEWLINE}打败这帮碍事的家伙！
strings.en: Silver: Fine, I’ll team up with you{NEWLINE}this once. Let’s beat these pests!

strings.zh: 小银『不能战斗了就给我让开,{NEWLINE}别在这碍事！
strings.en: Silver: If you can’t fight anymore, get{NEWLINE}out of my way. Quit being a nuisance!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『我这边就快好了,{NEWLINE}你们给我守住！
strings.en: Ariana: I’m almost done{NEWLINE}over here. Hold them off!

strings.zh: 是！雅典娜大人！
strings.en: Yes, Master Ariana!

strings.zh: 为了火箭队,拼了！
strings.en: For Team Rocket, all or nothing!

strings.zh: 小银『简直不堪一击,闪一边去吧！
strings.en: Silver: Pathetic. Out of my way!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『小银大人,你确实是成长了。{NEWLINE}但是只给那个冠军当帮手的话,{CLEAR}你永远超越不了你父亲哦。
strings.en: Ariana: You really have grown,{NEWLINE}Master Silver. But if all you do{CLEAR}is play sidekick to that Champion,{CLEAR}you’ll never surpass your father.

strings.zh: 小银『我说能超越就是能超越,{NEWLINE}用不着你来多嘴！
strings.en: Silver: If I say I’ll surpass{NEWLINE}him, I will! Nobody asked you!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『冷静,小银。{NEWLINE}她在扰乱你的心态。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Calm down, Silver.{NEWLINE}She’s trying to get in your head.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『你这个臭冠军{NEWLINE}是既想阻止我们抓炎帝,{CLEAR}又想拐跑我们首领的儿子吗？{CLEAR}真是太不把我们火箭队放在眼里了,{CLEAR}我今天一定要给你点苦头尝尝！
strings.en: Ariana: You rotten Champion, you{NEWLINE}want to stop us catching Entei{CLEAR}AND lure away our boss’s son?{SCROLL}You really don’t take Team{NEWLINE}Rocket seriously. Today I’m{CLEAR}going to make you suffer!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哈,哈……拖延了这么久,{NEWLINE}应该已经完成了吧。
strings.en: Ariana: Hah, hah... I’ve stalled long{NEWLINE}enough. It should be done by now.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队都被打败了,{NEWLINE}小银你去破坏装置救出炎帝吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Team Rocket’s all{NEWLINE}beaten. Silver, go destroy{CLEAR}the device and save Entei.

strings.zh: 小银『切,算我欠你一个人情。
strings.en: Silver: Tch. I guess I owe you one.

strings.zh: 小银『炎帝,控制器已经被破坏了。{NEWLINE}我现在要收服你了！
strings.en: Silver: Entei, the controller’s been{NEWLINE}destroyed. Now I’m going to catch you!

strings.zh: 小银『哎！？这感觉……？
strings.en: Silver: Huh?! This feeling...?

strings.zh: 雅典娜『嘿嘿……{SCROLL}雅典娜『炎帝,攻击大力鳄！
strings.en: Ariana: Heh heh...{SCROLL}Ariana: Entei, attack Feraligatr!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『好了炎帝,{NEWLINE}现在制服小银大人,{CLEAR}我要把他带回火箭队基地。
strings.en: Ariana: Good. Now, Entei, subdue{NEWLINE}Master Silver. I’m taking him{CLEAR}back to the Team Rocket base.

strings.zh: 小银『什么！？这到底是怎么回事！
strings.en: Silver: What?! What{NEWLINE}the hell is going on?!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『怎么会！{NEWLINE}明明已经破坏了装置。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: How?! We{NEWLINE}destroyed the device!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哈哈哈,蠢货冠军,{NEWLINE}你就是典型的一知半解。{CLEAR}只要控制装置洗脑的时间够长,{CLEAR}即使后来装置被破坏了,{CLEAR}炎帝也依然能被我们控制。
strings.en: Ariana: Hahaha, you idiot Champion,{NEWLINE}you’re the classic case of{CLEAR}knowing just enough to be wrong.{SCROLL}If the device brainwashes it long{NEWLINE}enough, we can still control Entei{CLEAR}even after the device is destroyed.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『有我在这里,{NEWLINE}你们休想伤害小银。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: As long as I’m here,{NEWLINE}you won’t lay a finger on Silver.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『我还从来没有{NEWLINE}使用传说中的精灵战斗过呢,{CLEAR}今天就让我用炎帝{CLEAR}来会一会你这个联盟冠军。
strings.en: Ariana: I’ve never battled with{NEWLINE}a legendary Pokémon before.{CLEAR}Today I’ll use Entei to take{CLEAR}on you, the League Champion.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『可恶啊,用炎帝也不行吗……
strings.en: Ariana: Dammit, not{NEWLINE}even Entei can do it...

strings.zh: 雅典娜『你们给我断后,{NEWLINE}我现在要带着炎帝撤离！
strings.en: Ariana: You lot cover our retreat.{NEWLINE}I’m pulling out with Entei now!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶！醒过来啊炎帝！{NEWLINE}不要被火箭队控制了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dammit! Wake up, Entei!{NEWLINE}Don’t let Team Rocket control you!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『没用的,洗脑一旦彻底完成,{NEWLINE}它就是我们火箭队的工具了。{CLEAR}哈哈哈,再见咯！
strings.en: Ariana: It’s no use. Once the{NEWLINE}brainwashing is complete, it’s a tool{CLEAR}of Team Rocket. Hahaha, bye now!

strings.zh: 小银『蠢货炎帝！你忘了你女儿了吗！
strings.en: Silver: You stupid Entei! Have{NEWLINE}you forgotten your daughter?!
strings.notes: 女儿 = Molly (Entei's 'daughter' from the Ruins of Alph scene).

strings.zh: 炎帝『Ennn……
strings.en: Entei: Ennn...

strings.zh: 雅典娜『女儿？
strings.en: Ariana: Daughter?

strings.zh: 小银『你不是跟你女儿约好了,{NEWLINE}要跟她再见面的吗！{CLEAR}你要是就这么被火箭队抓走,{CLEAR}就再也见不到你女儿了！
strings.en: Silver: Didn’t you promise your{NEWLINE}daughter you’d see her again?!{SCROLL}If you let Team Rocket take{NEWLINE}you away like this, you’ll never{CLEAR}see your daughter again!

strings.zh: 炎帝『Ennn——！
strings.en: Entei: Ennn-!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『喂,炎帝,别听他的！{NEWLINE}现在快走！走啊！
strings.en: Ariana: Hey, Entei, don’t{NEWLINE}listen to him! Now go! Go!

strings.zh: 小银『跟孩子的约定不能实现,{NEWLINE}为自己的无能找各种借口,{CLEAR}你这样跟我那个{CLEAR}混蛋父亲还有什么区别！{CLEAR}不想被你女儿讨厌的话,{CLEAR}就给我从洗脑中清醒过来啊！
strings.en: Silver: Breaking your promise to{NEWLINE}your kid, making all kinds of excuses{CLEAR}for your own uselessness...{SCROLL}How is that any different{NEWLINE}from my bastard of a father?!{SCROLL}If you don’t want your{NEWLINE}daughter to hate you, snap{CLEAR}out of that brainwashing!

strings.zh: 炎帝『Ennn——tei！{SCROLL}炎帝的眼神变了。
strings.en: Entei: Ennn-tei!{SCROLL}The look in Entei’s eyes changed.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『什么！？炎帝你！
strings.en: Ariana: What?! Entei, you...!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『喂！炎帝！
strings.en: Ariana: Hey! Entei!

strings.zh: 小银『哈哈哈,干得漂亮,炎帝！
strings.en: Silver: Hahaha! Nice work, Entei!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『今天的行动到此为止,{NEWLINE}都跟我撤退！
strings.en: Ariana: That’s it for today’s{NEWLINE}operation. Everyone, fall back with me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『炎帝逃走了,{NEWLINE}你们彻底失败了,火箭队！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Entei got away. You’ve{NEWLINE}failed completely, Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『你不要太得意忘形,{NEWLINE}我们的「R计划」还没有正式实施呢。{CLEAR}到时候有你们哭的！
strings.en: Ariana: Don’t get too full of yourself.{NEWLINE}Our Project R hasn’t even officially{CLEAR}begun. You’ll be crying soon enough!
{VAR:0103:0}: Project R?

strings.zh: 小银『火箭队从你和超梦的战斗中,{NEWLINE}找到了使用传说中的精灵{CLEAR}击败你的可能性。{CLEAR}雅典娜所说的「R计划」{CLEAR}大概就是这方面的东西。
strings.en: Silver: From your battle with{NEWLINE}Mewtwo, Team Rocket figured{CLEAR}out they might be able to beat{CLEAR}you using legendary Pokémon.{SCROLL}The Project R Ariana mentioned is{NEWLINE}probably something along those lines.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯……有可能。{NEWLINE}那你还有这个计划的其他情报吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hmm... Could be. Do{NEWLINE}you have any other information{CLEAR}about this project?

strings.zh: 小银『我早在一年多以前{NEWLINE}就独自离开了火箭队基地,{CLEAR}后面他们干了什么我就不知道了。
strings.en: Silver: I left the Team Rocket base{NEWLINE}on my own over a year ago. I don’t{CLEAR}know what they’ve done since.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队基地？{NEWLINE}他们还有隐藏的基地吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The Team Rocket base?{NEWLINE}Do they have another hidden base?

strings.zh: 小银『我说的基地是火箭队设在{NEWLINE}研钵山洞穴里的尖兵训练营。{CLEAR}我离开那不久后就听说{CLEAR}精灵联盟派人突袭了那个基地。{CLEAR}但据说当时精灵联盟扑了个空,{CLEAR}应该是火箭队提前搬走了。{CLEAR}至于搬去了哪里……{CLEAR}我觉得火箭队能搬得悄无声息,{CLEAR}那他们搬去的地方{CLEAR}距离研钵山应该不会很远。{CLEAR}你要是想调查火箭队的事,{CLEAR}就在研钵山、卡吉镇这一带找找看吧。
strings.en: Silver: The base I mean is the boot camp{NEWLINE}Team Rocket set up in the caves of{CLEAR}Mt. Mortar.{SCROLL}Not long after I left, I heard the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League sent people to raid it.{CLEAR}But supposedly the League came up{CLEAR}empty-handed, so Team Rocket must{CLEAR}have moved out beforehand.{SCROLL}As for where they went... Team Rocket{NEWLINE}managed to move without a sound, so I{CLEAR}don’t think the new place can be very{CLEAR}far from Mt. Mortar.{SCROLL}If you want to investigate Team{NEWLINE}Rocket, look around Mt. Mortar and{CLEAR}Mahogany Town.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你提供了{NEWLINE}这么珍贵的情报。{CLEAR}我果然没有看错,{CLEAR}你跟你父亲不一样,{CLEAR}你是一个外冷内热、{CLEAR}有正义感的训练家。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thanks for such{NEWLINE}valuable information.{SCROLL}I knew I was right about you. You’re{NEWLINE}not like your father. You’re cool on{CLEAR}the outside but warm on the inside,{CLEAR}a Trainer with a sense of justice.

strings.zh: 小银『少在那自以为是。{NEWLINE}你帮我救出炎帝,{CLEAR}我给你提供情报,{CLEAR}咱们互不相欠了,再见！
strings.en: Silver: Don’t flatter yourself.{NEWLINE}You helped me save Entei, I gave{CLEAR}you information. We’re even. Bye!

strings.zh: 小银『大力鳄,破坏这个奇怪的装置！
strings.en: Silver: Feraligatr,{NEWLINE}destroy this weird device!

strings.zh: 太阳珊瑚『Coooo——so！
strings.en: Corsola: Coooo-so!

strings.zh: 你也想来这一带钓鱼吗？{NEWLINE}让我看看你够不够资格！
strings.en: You want to fish around here too?{NEWLINE}Let’s see if you’re good enough!

strings.zh: 我认可你了,{NEWLINE}你有资格在这一带钓鱼。{CLEAR}这种球对钓上来的精灵很有效果,{CLEAR}送你几个试试吧。
strings.en: You’ve got my approval. You’re{NEWLINE}good enough to fish around here.{SCROLL}These Balls work great on hooked{NEWLINE}Pokémon. Take a few and try them out.

strings.zh: 愤怒湖杂七杂八的游客太多了,{NEWLINE}完全没法安心钓鱼,{CLEAR}还是这里比较安静。{CLEAR}不过你可不要到处跟人家说,{CLEAR}万一来钓鱼的人变多就不好了。
strings.en: There are way too many random tourists{NEWLINE}at the Lake of Rage. You can’t fish in{CLEAR}peace at all. It’s much quieter here.{SCROLL}But don’t go telling everyone{NEWLINE}about it. It’d be bad if more{CLEAR}people started coming here to fish.

strings.zh: 火箭队曾在这个洞穴里建立基地,{NEWLINE}为了防止类似的事情再发生,{CLEAR}这一带必须要加强警戒。
strings.en: Team Rocket once built a base{NEWLINE}in this cave. To keep anything like{CLEAR}that from happening again, we have{CLEAR}to step up security around here.

strings.zh: 我的图图犬在对战中缺少攻击性,{NEWLINE}我决定让它加练怪力术,{CLEAR}好让它能给敌人造成足够的伤害。
strings.en: My Smeargle lacks aggression in{NEWLINE}battle, so I’ve decided to have{CLEAR}it practice Strength so it can{CLEAR}deal enough damage to the enemy.

strings.zh: 图图犬『Smeee——gle！
strings.en: Smeargle: Smeee-gle!

strings.zh: 一块用来练习怪力术的大石头。
strings.en: A big boulder for practicing Strength.
strings.notes: 怪力术 read as the move Strength.

strings.zh: 你看到那边的幸福蛋了吗？{NEWLINE}幸福蛋妈妈正在孵蛋呢！{CLEAR}我要拍下这个美好的瞬间。
strings.en: See the Blissey over there? The{NEWLINE}mama Blissey is keeping her Egg warm!{SCROLL}I want to photograph{NEWLINE}this wonderful moment.

strings.zh: 我刚刚看到一个红发少{NEWLINE}年追着一只没见过的精灵,{CLEAR}嗖地一下就跑过去了。
strings.en: I just saw a red-haired boy chasing{NEWLINE}a Pokémon I’ve never seen before.{CLEAR}Whoosh, he dashed right past.

strings.zh: 我在研钵山跟空手道大王信彦{NEWLINE}修行过之后,{CLEAR}已经能跟我的精灵{CLEAR}心意相通融为一体了,{CLEAR}你愿意跟这样的我来一场对战吗？
strings.en: After training at Mt. Mortar with Kiyo{NEWLINE}the Karate King, I can now become{CLEAR}one with my Pokémon, heart and soul.{SCROLL}Would you battle someone like me?

strings.zh: 你喜欢单打还是双打？
strings.en: Would you like a Single or a{NEWLINE}Double Battle?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 在实战中跟精灵培养友情,{NEWLINE}这是最好的方法了！
strings.en: Building friendship with Pokémon in{NEWLINE}real battles is the best way there is!

strings.zh: 我能感受到你和你的精灵{NEWLINE}一起经历过很多事情,{CLEAR}你们这种心意相通的境界,{CLEAR}我完全比不了啊。{CLEAR}以后如果还有机会,{CLEAR}请让我再观摩一下你和精灵的默契。
strings.en: I can feel that you and your Pokémon{NEWLINE}have been through a lot together.{SCROLL}I’m nowhere near that level{NEWLINE}of being in tune. If I ever get the{CLEAR}chance, please let me watch you and{CLEAR}your Pokémon work together again.

strings.zh: 双打要两只精灵才可以哦。
strings.en: You need two Pokémon{NEWLINE}for a Double Battle.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『到此为止了,{NEWLINE}我不会让你们再前进一步。
strings.en: Ariana: This is as far as you go. I{NEWLINE}won’t let you take one more step.

strings.zh: 小银『凭你也想阻止我们？{NEWLINE}真是不自量力。
strings.en: Silver: You think you can{NEWLINE}stop us? Don’t make me laugh.

strings.zh: 图图犬不是这么练的
strings.en: That’s no way to train Smeargle
strings.notes: choice: #102 advise on Sketch (#104–#112, Heart Scale gift) / #103 leave.

strings.zh: 那你加油练吧
strings.en: Good luck with that

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『每个精灵都有它擅长{NEWLINE}和不擅长的方面,{CLEAR}用好图图犬并不靠提升力量,{CLEAR}而是活用它的技能「写生」。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Every Pokémon has things{NEWLINE}it’s good and bad at. The way to use{CLEAR}Smeargle well isn’t raising its power,{CLEAR}but making good use of its move Sketch.

strings.zh: 哎？写生吗？{NEWLINE}可是我的图图犬用写生模仿的{CLEAR}都是撞击、摇尾巴这一类技能,{CLEAR}威力实在是太低。{CLEAR}所以我才想让它好好锻炼力量{CLEAR}增强攻击力。
strings.en: Huh? Sketch? But the moves my{NEWLINE}Smeargle copies with Sketch are{CLEAR}all things like Tackle and Tail{CLEAR}Whip. Their power’s way too low.{SCROLL}That’s why I wanted it to train its{NEWLINE}strength and boost its attack power.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那就去找{NEWLINE}会用强力技能的对手,{CLEAR}模仿它们的技能吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then find opponents that{NEWLINE}use powerful moves and copy those.

strings.zh: 其实,我的图图犬{NEWLINE}四个技能都已经模仿完了,{CLEAR}现在已经不会写生了。
strings.en: Actually, my Smeargle has already{NEWLINE}filled all four moves with copies.{CLEAR}It doesn’t know Sketch anymore.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那就用心之鳞片{NEWLINE}帮它回忆起写生技能。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then use a Heart Scale{NEWLINE}to help it remember Sketch.

strings.zh: 我是个很业余的训练家,{NEWLINE}心之鳞片这种东西我压根没有。
strings.en: I’m a total amateur Trainer. I don’t{NEWLINE}have anything like a Heart Scale.

strings.zh: 要把身上的心之鳞片送给他吗？
strings.en: Give him the Heart Scale you have?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我这里正好有一个心之鳞片,{NEWLINE}你需要的话就送给你吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I happen to have a Heart{NEWLINE}Scale. If you need it, you can have it.

strings.zh: 真的吗？太感谢你了！{NEWLINE}这样我的图图犬就能学新的技能了！{CLEAR}不过我不能白拿你的东西,{CLEAR}这个送给你当作回礼吧！
strings.en: Really? Thank you so much! Now{NEWLINE}my Smeargle can learn new moves!{SCROLL}But I can’t take your stuff for{NEWLINE}nothing. Please take this in return!

strings.zh: 我要调整一下使用图图犬的思路,{NEWLINE}不能只给它学大威力技能,{CLEAR}得让它变得捉摸不透一些。
strings.en: I need to rethink how I use{NEWLINE}Smeargle. I shouldn’t just teach{CLEAR}it high-power moves. I need{CLEAR}to make it harder to predict.

strings.zh: 那个是……饭匙蛇？{NEWLINE}它好像要偷幸福蛋的蛋！
strings.en: Is that... a Seviper? Looks like{NEWLINE}it wants to steal Blissey’s Egg!

strings.zh: 不好了,饭匙蛇准备攻击幸福蛋了,{NEWLINE}你应该是训练家吧,{CLEAR}快去救救幸福蛋的小宝宝吧！
strings.en: Oh no, the Seviper is about to attack{NEWLINE}Blissey! You’re a Trainer, right?{CLEAR}Hurry and save Blissey’s baby!

strings.zh: 我去救它
strings.en: I’ll save it
strings.notes: choice: #116 save Blissey (#126–#130) / #117 let nature be (#118–#125, Blissey wins alone).

strings.zh: 尊重自然,不要插手
strings.en: Let nature be

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『捕食与被捕食,{NEWLINE}这也是精灵的生存之道,{CLEAR}咱们还是不要干涉了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Eat or be eaten,{NEWLINE}that’s how Pokémon survive{CLEAR}too. We’d better not interfere.

strings.zh: 你这个人真是没有同情心,{NEWLINE}这么可爱的幸福蛋{CLEAR}和它即将出生的宝宝,{CLEAR}你就这么眼睁睁地看着它们{CLEAR}遭到饭匙蛇的毒手吗？
strings.en: You have no compassion at all! Are{NEWLINE}you just going to stand there and{CLEAR}watch this adorable Blissey and her{CLEAR}unborn baby fall prey to Seviper?

strings.zh: 不好了,饭匙蛇要发起攻击了！
strings.en: Oh no, the Seviper’s about to strike!

strings.zh: 饭匙蛇『Seee——vip！
strings.en: Seviper: Seee-vip!

strings.zh: 幸福蛋『Bliii——sey！
strings.en: Blissey: Bliii-sey!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,你看到了没有？{NEWLINE}幸福蛋击退了饭匙蛇,{CLEAR}这就是母爱的力量,{CLEAR}这就是自然的奇迹！
strings.en: Hahaha, did you see that? Blissey{NEWLINE}drove off the Seviper! That’s{CLEAR}the power of a mother’s love!{CLEAR}That’s the miracle of nature!

strings.zh: 小福蛋『Haaa——piny！
strings.en: Happiny: Haaa-piny!

strings.zh: 啊！劫后余生、母子平安,{NEWLINE}真的是太感人了,{CLEAR}我要用相机记录下这美好的一幕。
strings.en: Ah! They survived, and mother{NEWLINE}and baby are both safe! It’s so{CLEAR}moving. I have to capture this{CLEAR}wonderful scene with my camera.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好,我去赶跑饭匙蛇！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Right, I’ll{NEWLINE}chase off the Seviper!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『饭匙蛇,今天幸福蛋{NEWLINE}要孵化小宝宝,{CLEAR}就委屈你饿一下肚子吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sorry, Seviper, but Blissey’s{NEWLINE}baby is hatching today. You’ll{CLEAR}just have to go hungry for once!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『呼,这样就安全了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Phew, it’s safe now.

strings.zh: 太棒了,小福蛋平安出生了！
strings.en: Hooray, the Happiny hatched safely!

strings.zh: 真的是太感谢你了！{NEWLINE}我跟拍这只幸福蛋很久了,{CLEAR}所以不忍心看它在孵化前遭到不测,{CLEAR}也幸好有你出手相救,{CLEAR}小福蛋才能顺利出生。{SCROLL}这个是我的一点心意,{NEWLINE}请你收下吧。
strings.en: Thank you so much! I’ve been following{NEWLINE}this Blissey with my camera for ages,{CLEAR}so I couldn’t bear to see something{CLEAR}happen to it before the Egg hatched.{SCROLL}Luckily you stepped in to save it,{NEWLINE}so the Happiny could be born safely.{SCROLL}Please accept this small{NEWLINE}token of my thanks.

strings.zh: 口袋妖怪带给我们的{NEWLINE}不只是生活上的便利,{CLEAR}还有心灵上的治愈。{CLEAR}我要把精灵们幸福的笑容拍下来,{CLEAR}去治愈更多的人！
strings.en: Pokémon don’t just make our lives more{NEWLINE}convenient. They heal our hearts too.{SCROLL}I’m going to photograph{NEWLINE}Pokémon smiling happily and{CLEAR}bring healing to more people!
